verdict.rationale: kitty's own docs advertise "programmable tabs, splits and multiple layouts to manage windows" plus an "Arrange windows" section and startup sessions for working environments, so pane and tab management is built in rather than delegated to tmux. A hands-on probe where `kitten @ ls` returned live window, tab and layout state, along with users praising its window organisation and auto layout, independently corroborates this. Missing for 10: in-depth evidence of split mechanics (creating, resizing and navigating panes, layout types), and documentation of tab-management workflows beyond one-line summaries.
